title: CMake+tools: Remove our text release notes
description:
Remove our text release notes target and related conversion script. This
was used to generate our release announcement emails, and I'm switching
to HTML.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
